item.title: BART riders to pay more in 2026 as fares rise
item.description: BART will raise fares by 6.2% on New Year’s Day, citing inflation and long-term financial pressures, even as ridership continues to climb across much of the transit system, the transit agency said. The post BART riders to pay more in 2026 as fares rise appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Woman arraigned on charges of attempted murder, stalking of San Ramon teen
item.description: A Union City woman who allegedly shot a teenager last month in San Ramon was arraigned Wednesday on charges of attempted murder, stalking, child abuse and making criminal threats, prosecutors said. item.title: Grand jury indicts three current, former deputies in Santa Rita Jail death case
item.description: A criminal grand jury has indicted three current and former Alameda County sheriff’s deputies in the 2021 in-custody death of Maurice Monk at Santa Rita Jail, the Alameda County District Attorney’s Office said. The post Grand jury indicts three current, former deputies in Santa Rita Jail death case appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Tri-Valley celebrates Hanukkah while honoring Bondi Beach victims
item.description: In the wake of a mass shooting this past weekend during a Hanukkah celebration at Bondi Beach in Australia, Rabbis within Tri-Valley’s Jewish community remain undaunted through their mourning as local organizations are scheduled to host events this week in observance of the holiday.
